scope: read-only temporal, archive reuse, ordering, controller and cost review of the exact RF-02F historical protocol draft; no statistical gate redefinition or historical execution
accepted_design_elements: The 27-setting table matches the accepted grid, retains original diagonal ordering, freezes full-family selection on exactly Y-2/Y-1 and excludes all 2025 outcomes from tuning.
216 new state trajectories and 81 borrowed diagonal outputs correctly separate complete own histories, zero-S/P variants, original O/D masks and output-only variants.
The fixed raw references, unchanged joint mapper/scorer and same-variant/same-delay N0 fallbacks retain native reasons and original control identity.
Exact prior input contents and full semantic ancestry are required; the draft correctly requires abort after partly mutating delivery errors and whole-origin publication before grader access.

The single overall 7,200-second/4,096-MiB envelope begins before admission/runtime/smoke/creation. Its two original retained pilot origins, one new identity, no restart, stop prohibition and invalid-only 30-second grace are explicit.
The later atomic Store boundary, immutable invalid prefix and independent actual-terminal review are appropriate. No new code or protocol label is treated as a historical or prospective result.
The original C/E negative decisions, D invalid status, private research restriction and unchanged external five-percent/prospective requirements remain explicit.

blockers.finding: The real capacity smoke is described as complete development-size metadata, while the declared public evaluator input is all 19 series on 3,407 ordered games and its development filtering must happen internally. A 3,135-only caller either violates the actual population validator or times a reduced internal entry point, omitting some public evaluation work.
blockers.minimal_fix: Specify one full synthetic 3,407-row-per-series input with 226 origins, original complete year counts, 3,135 development and 272 exposed-2025 rows. T must time the actual public evaluator, including declared scorecard/calibration/PIT/coverage work and all three complete bootstraps; smoke clock includes fixture authentication/loading and its declared persistence/reload path. An already-qualified hash-bound synthetic fixture may be reused without regenerating it during smoke.

blockers.finding: The bank borrows 81 diagonal outputs at every one of 277 origins, but the pinned archive has forecast/ancestry/mapper artifacts only from 2010 week 6 onward. The first five warmup origins have state and warmup artifacts only. The draft requires full cache/ancestry authentication without naming this necessary absence exception.
blockers.minimal_fix: Freeze exactly 2010 weeks 1–5 as state-only warmup cache origins: verify their indexed state/warmup payloads and admitted origin/input/target closures, advance all own histories, require no distribution/score, and do not require nonexistent forecast ancestry. All later required forecast/ancestry/mapper absences remain invalid. Also identify full_setting_forecasts N0 setting 0 as the inner-fallback source for 2011–2012, which have no outer-selected N0 records.

blockers.finding: The exact E3 outer-metric reuse rule is underdetermined when the enlarged family selects the same diagonal as original E2. The text explicitly distinguishes a different diagonal, but does not say whether the same diagonal borrows metrics or is rescored. Moreover an early selected diagonal can recover archived variant laws while a later off-diagonal requires new fits; max observed pilot seconds/game alone does not measure an unobserved expensive route. This does not defeat the hard deadline, but the stated conservative projection needs a declared workload interpretation.
blockers.minimal_fix: Freeze the complete row/call route before fitting: whether all 13 E3 outer metric dictionaries are newly scored or exactly eligible dictionaries may be reused, which selected laws may be recovered, and actual call accounting. Either use a uniform declared per-game route or add a preregistered conservative allowance for all later missing law fits/outer scoring not exercised by the retained pilot. A synthetic qualified worst-case route is acceptable; do not tune the allowance or branch after seeing new scientific results.

blockers.finding: The draft calls 65,646 new inner scores a maximum, although a complete 18-setting × 3,647-game path must score fallback for native failures as well. That wording could admit a complete terminal with skipped difficult rows.
blockers.minimal_fix: Require exactly 65,646 new inner score occurrences and exactly 32,823 reused diagonal inner records for a complete run, including failure/fallback rows. Smaller completed counts are permitted only for an immutable protocol-invalid prefix, never for a successful research terminal. Freeze 44,291 E3 outer rows plus 20,442 raw reference rows = 64,733 total evaluator rows.

implementation_notes_not_additional_expe: Stream full index/hash authentication and keep compact pointers/current-origin data rather than retaining all decoded raw archive payloads. The source archive is 1.862GB on disk and its state JSON alone is 650.6MB; a full decoded cache plus 216 engines could exceed the 4GiB bound. Clarify whether full cache validation means the complete fixed source population versus simultaneous residency.

If smoke runs in a child, budget and stop handling must cover child lifetime and relevant simultaneous RSS; do not leave a child evaluator running after the parent deadline. A same-process design can avoid that ambiguity.

Start each measured pilot origin before its cache loading, prior closure verification and annual selection, not immediately before advance; all listed work must be included. Retain raw t1/t2, game/history counts and exact remaining-origin terms.

The final machine registry/acceptance must bind exact model/source/test/protocol/runtime and prior acceptance graph without cycles; missing future source bytes remain global-admission invalid, while local prior-only invariance tests are separately scoped.

At integration review, explicitly test the RF-02D timeout/strict-native-number boundary and post-publication finalization guard. A swallowed deadline or late fsync must not cause more scientific work or competing terminals.
limitations: This is not protocol freeze, implementation acceptance or historical pre-fit authorization. It requests small explicit clarifications rather than a new model/feature search.
No historical fit, score, distribution recovery, provider/site operation or frozen-file edit was performed. Only the pinned archive index metadata was read for source-layout and byte-cost evidence.
Prior immutable qualification/audits were reused within their stated scopes. No full archive-byte audit or benchmark timing was repeated.
Numerical inference/gate mathematics remain for the independent numerical reviewer; this review does not approve unstated statistical interpretations.
